title: Config Safepoint Coordinator and Batching-Aware Cache Advisor
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Changes to runtime config (batching, kv-cache, quantization flags) have caused transient cost and latency regressions in production. We need an automated system that creates a deploy safepoint around config changes, evaluates runtime cost/latency signatures, and either commits, holds, or rolls back changes with clear guardrails. This ticket covers a coordinator service (safepoint manager) plus a lightweight advisor that recommends batching and caching parameter tweaks before apply and during canary windows. The goal is to reduce manual rollbacks and surface cost tradeoffs immediately while ensuring safe state reconciliation.
proposal: Build a Config Safepoint Coordinator that: (1) captures a pre-change snapshot of relevant runtime state (active model variants, KV cache warmup heuristics, batching distribution percentiles), (2) gates deployment by running a synthetic and sampled live validation suite (latency/cost/throughput), (3) exposes a hold-and-validate mode where changes are staged with traffic mirroring, and (4) triggers automated rollback or staged rollforward based on predefined economic and SLO thresholds. Add a Batching-Aware Cache Advisor that analyzes recent traffic patterns and recommends batch size ceilings, batch hold thresholds, and prefix-KV caching TTLs prior to config apply. The coordinator will persist safepoint metadata and reconciliation actions for forensic audit and post-mortem analysis.
non_goals: This ticket does not implement a full rollout dashboard UI (only exposes APIs and console hooks), nor does it change existing controller autoscaling policies. It also does not onboard every legacy config flag in the first iteration — initial scope is batching, kv-cache, and request-merging flags.
design_decisions: Safepoint is an append-only artifact stored in config metadata and object store (compact snapshot of keys + sample telemetry).
Validation suite includes both synthetic microbench marks and live sampled canary traffic mirrored to a canary pool.
Guardrail policy language uses declarative thresholds: latency_p50, latency_p95, token_cost_delta_pct, error_rate_delta_pct, warmup_time_seconds.
Automated actions: commit, hold (manual review), rollback. Rollback performs idempotent state reconciliation including KV cache quarantine and targeted pre-warm routines.
Advisor uses a sliding window of 72 hours of request shape metadata to suggest batching ceilings and KV TTLs, favoring conservative settings when token-cost increase > 8%.
Security: coordinator requests must be signed and logged; KMS keys used for any encrypted state snapshots.
telemetry_requirements: per-config-change event with safepoint_id, initiator, changed_keys
live canary metrics: request_count, tokens_generated, cost_estimate, latency p50/p95, failure_rate
batching distribution histograms (requested_seq_len, produced_tokens, batch_size) sampled at 1%
kv-cache warmup convergence metric (miss_rate over warmup window)
acceptance_criteria: API endpoint to create a safepoint exists and returns safepoint_id
Coordinator can stage a config change in hold-and-validate mode and mirror sampled traffic to canary pool
Advisor returns batching/cache recommendations with confidence score and estimated token_cost_delta
Automated rollback path reverts config and executes KV cache quarantine and pre-warm hooks without manual intervention
All safepoint actions are auditable: persisted snapshot, telemetry links, and reconciliation log
E2E test simulating a cost-regressive change triggers automated rollback in CI canary harness
SLOs: rollback decision latency < 3 minutes from trigger, reconciliation completion < 15 minutes for typical change
tasks: Define safepoint schema and storage location (DB + object store)
Implement safepoint creation API and ACL checks
Implement canary mirror plumbing into canary GPU pool
Build lightweight validation runner (synthetic + sampled live checks)
Implement advisor microservice for batching/cache recommendations
Implement automated action engine (commit/hold/rollback) with idempotency guarantees
Integrate telemetry emitters and dashboards (console hooks)
Write e2e tests and chaos scenarios for KV cache reconciliation
Run security review and KMS integration
